scope.decision: Layer 7 gates automated Claude and Codex independent correctness and parity. Genuine interactive Claude agent-team verification is separate, manual, and not a pull-request blocker.
scope.authorization: Implementation and quota-backed native runs are user-authorized. This audit revision does not itself invoke either model.
scope.non_claim: Replay, parser, schema, invariant, dry-run, catalog validation, and migration success are not native provider qualification and do not complete the original performance acceptance goal.

integration_return_catalog_slice.status: Authored and covered by provider-free corpus controls; live qualification pending. Both clients require dedicated named synthesis with distinct native role identifiers and transport receipts.

current_adoption.limitations: Parity 01 awaits native qualification. Parity 02 additionally requires both reused functional pairs before composite completion. The proposal counts, artifacts, and gap text below preserve the earlier four-candidate checkpoint and are not current adoption or qualification evidence.

parity_catalog_slice.shared_gap: Both adapters now support controlled baseline/feature Git fixtures and retained controller Git observations. This does not yet qualify autopilot workflow binding, worktree registration, or branch behavior for these four pending parity cases. Their native prerequisites and divergent workflow sequences remain to be reconciled before live qualification. No provider trial of these four cases has been accepted.
parity_catalog_slice.teams_amendment: The new cases contain no teams mode, team environment fixture, TeamCreate or TeamDelete requirement, or teams-versus-fallback comparison. They retain ordinary-subagent ownership, ordering, return attribution, functional workflow artifacts, and parent serial decisions. Genuine interactive teams remain a separate manual non-blocking activity.
